decision_reason: A standing, AUTHORIZED grant (G-KOS-CONTRACT-ARTIFACT-UPDATE-AMD3) explicitly forbids modifying expected.json pending a formal PO/ARB gate transition; no such transition exists for this act. Per this corpus's own stated rule ('the grant is the authority; a standing bar is lifted by an amendment BEFORE the act, not by a decision recorded only downstream') the procedural/record-level verdict is UNAUTHORIZED. Whether the underlying human decision was itself legitimate is a separate question this evidence cannot resolve, and is recorded as UNDERDETERMINED rather than adjudicated. This exact split mirrors an independent, real, prior governance finding already on record in this corpus (commit 6b983bc12's own CV-1 analysis: 'GOVERNANCE — RECORDING GAP, NOT A BREACH OF SUBSTANCE... the record as it stands cannot show what authorized the change'), arrived at before this gold-standard experiment began — treated here as a third, independent corroborating source, not as the source of the adjudication itself.
